draft:
The Cravenford Private Investments Fund is a non-diversified, closed-end tender offer fund registered under the 1940 and 1933 Acts. Fund net asset value was $653.0 billion at 31 March 2026. The Fund held 61 companies at that date. Those companies sit across more than 40 general partner relationships. Cravenford has a 40+ year track record of investing across all private market asset classes.

Total assets under management across all strategies were $161.0 billion. The firm employs 233 investment professionals. Class A returned -2.45% in the twelve months to 31 March 2026. Class A returned 3.35% over the twelve months to 31 March 2026. The Fund's net asset value net of the incentive fee accrual was $653.0 million.

Direct investments represent 88% of the portfolio and secondaries 12%. North America accounts for 70% of the portfolio, with Europe at 25%. Class A returned -1.06% in January 2026. Asia and Australia together account for 5% of the portfolio. The Fund's net asset value was $0.653 billion.

The Fund is perpetual in term. All investors must be Qualified Clients. The minimum initial subscription for Class I is $1,000,000. Repurchase offers are expected quarterly and are capped at 5% of net asset value. Class D and Class I both showed a net asset value per share of 10.17.
